root: ^You and Mira step into the town center. It’s quiet, but full of life—the wind blows gently, a merchant arranges jars of preserved herbs, and someone is fixing a broken sign with bits of scrap metal.
^"This is the Town Square. We don’t have monuments or fancy houses, but... it’s ours."
^"Most of this was built from the ruins outside the city. Broken things they threw away—we gave them purpose again."
^Looks like you’re doing more than surviving.
^Doesn’t the city get suspicious when all this goes up?
^This place is a ticking time bomb. The city will find it.

c-0: ^"We try. Hope’s hard to come by out here, but we find ways to hold onto it."
c-1: ^Mira: "They don’t know. Or maybe they don’t care enough to look this far out. We’re not supposed to exist."
c-2: ^Mira: "...Maybe. But until they do, we’ll keep helping each other. That’s all we can do."

continue: ^She walks toward the makeshift stands in the center, her fingers brushing its worn wood.
^"They say the old city had leaders from every race—until the fae decided unity wasn’t efficient enough."
^"We’re what’s left of that dream. Not rebels. Just people who still believe we all deserve a place to belong."
^A bell rings in the distance—two short tones. A sign that midday is ending.
^"Come on. There’s still more to see."
